story.title: Our Story
story.subtitle: How we became leaders in academic hosting solutions
paragraphs: Paideia Hosting was founded with a clear mission: to provide specialized hosting solutions for academic institutions and scholarly publishing. Born from the needs we observed while working with universities, research centers, and academic publishers, we recognized that standard hosting solutions weren't meeting the unique requirements of scholarly communication platforms.

As part of the larger Paideia Publishing Services ecosystem, we leverage our deep understanding of academic workflows and publishing processes to create hosting environments that are optimized for platforms like Open Journal Systems (OJS), Open Monograph Press (OMP), Dataverse, and Access to Memory (AtoM).

Our team combines expertise in both information technology and scholarly publishing, allowing us to bridge the gap between technical requirements and academic needs. This unique perspective has enabled us to grow from a small hosting provider to a trusted partner for academic institutions across Latin America and beyond.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our AWS backup solutions

items.question: What types of data can I backup?
items.answer: Any type of institutional data: research databases, OJS journals, DSpace repositories, Dataverse datasets, AtoM archives, and general server backups.

items.question: How is data security handled?
items.answer: All data is encrypted both in transit and at rest using AWS encryption standards. Optional Object Lock provides immutability for compliance requirements.

items.question: Can I change my retention period later?
items.answer: Yes, you can adjust retention policies at contract renewal. However, existing backups will follow their original retention schedule.

items.question: What happens if I exceed my contracted storage?
items.answer: We'll notify you at 80% and 95% of your quota. You can upgrade your plan anytime, or we'll discuss options when you reach the limit.

items.question: How do I restore my data?
items.answer: Simply contact our support team with your restoration request. We'll initiate the recovery process and provide a secure download link once ready.

items.question: Is there a setup fee?
items.answer: Setup fees apply only for volumes under 300 GB ($600 for Preservation Plus, $800 for Active Guard). Volumes of 300 GB or more include free setup.

items.question: Can I combine both plans?
items.answer: Yes! Many institutions use Active Guard for operational servers and Preservation Plus for long-term archival storage. Contact us for bundled pricing.

items.question: What payment terms are available?
items.answer: We offer annual payment terms only. Multi-year contracts (2-10 years) receive discounted rates for Preservation Plus.

items.question: Do you offer geographic replication?
items.answer: Yes, as an add-on service. Your data can be replicated across multiple AWS regions for enhanced disaster recovery (+50% on base price).

items.question: What monitoring and reporting is included?
items.answer: All plans include automated monitoring with monthly email reports showing storage usage, backup status, and quota utilization. Premium reporting available as an add-on.

items.question: Can you help us migrate existing backups?
items.answer: Yes, we offer migration services to transfer your existing backups to our AWS infrastructure. Contact our sales team for migration assistance and pricing.

items.question: What SLAs do you provide?
items.answer: Preservation Plus: 72 business hours recovery. Active Guard: 30 minutes to 2 hours for recent data, 24-48 hours for archived data. SLA 99.9% uptime available as add-on.

items.q: What repository platforms do you support?
items.a: We support the latest stable versions of Dataverse and DSpace, and can help you migrate from older versions or other platforms.

items.q: Can I migrate my existing repository?
items.a: Yes, we offer migration services to help you move your existing Dataverse, DSpace, or other repository to our hosting platform.

items.q: How is data security handled?
items.a: We implement multiple layers of security including encrypted storage, regular security audits, and compliance with academic data protection standards.

items.q: Do you support DOI integration?

items.q: Can I customize the repository interface?

items.q: What happens if I exceed my storage limit?
